panels.title: Unrealized PnL

targets.rawSql:
WITH meta AS ( SELECT symbol, timeframe, data_source FROM backtest_runs WHERE run_id='${run_id}'),
latest_signal AS (
  SELECT ts, signal_value,
    (SELECT close FROM ohlcv, meta WHERE symbol = meta.symbol AND timeframe = meta.timeframe AND (meta.data_source IS NULL OR data_source = meta.data_source) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS current_close,
    (SELECT close FROM ohlcv, meta WHERE symbol = meta.symbol AND timeframe = meta.timeframe AND (meta.data_source IS NULL OR data_source = meta.data_source) AND ts <= s.ts ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS signal_price
  FROM signal_events s
  WHERE s.run_id = '${run_id}'
  ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT $expected_direction * (current_close - signal_price) / NULLIF(signal_price, 0) AS "PnL"
FROM latest_signal
WHERE current_close IS NOT NULL AND signal_price IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Latest signal's unrealized return: expected_direction x (current_price - signal_price) / signal_price.

panels.title: Mean Fwd Return (T+$n)

targets.rawSql:
WITH meta AS ( SELECT symbol, timeframe, data_source FROM backtest_runs WHERE run_id='${run_id}'),
fwd AS (
  SELECT s.ts,
    (exit_bar.close - entry_bar.close) / NULLIF(entry_bar.close, 0) AS ret
  FROM signal_events s, meta
  JOIN LATERAL (SELECT close FROM ohlcv, meta WHERE symbol = meta.symbol AND timeframe = meta.timeframe AND (meta.data_source IS NULL OR data_source = meta.data_source) AND ts <= s.ts ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) entry_bar ON true
  JOIN LATERAL (SELECT close FROM ohlcv, meta WHERE symbol = meta.symbol AND timeframe = meta.timeframe AND (meta.data_source IS NULL OR data_source = meta.data_source) AND ts > s.ts ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1 OFFSET ($n - 1)) exit_bar ON true
  WHERE s.run_id = '${run_id}'
    AND $__timeFilter(s.ts)
)
SELECT $expected_direction * AVG(ret) AS "Mean Ret" FROM fwd

panels.description: expected_direction x AVG(forward return over n bars).

panels.title: Edge Ratio (T+$n)

targets.rawSql:
WITH meta AS ( SELECT symbol, timeframe, data_source FROM backtest_runs WHERE run_id='${run_id}'),
exc AS (
  SELECT s.ts, exc.mfe, exc.mae,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.ts) AS rn
  FROM signal_events s, meta
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT close AS entry_close FROM ohlcv
    WHERE symbol = meta.symbol AND timeframe = meta.timeframe AND (meta.data_source IS NULL OR data_source = meta.data_source) AND ts <= s.ts
    ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
  ) entry_bar ON true
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      MAX((b.high - entry_bar.entry_close) / NULLIF(entry_bar.entry_close, 0)) AS mfe,
      MAX((entry_bar.entry_close - b.low) / NULLIF(entry_bar.entry_close, 0)) AS mae
    FROM (
      SELECT high, low FROM ohlcv
      WHERE symbol = meta.symbol AND timeframe = meta.timeframe AND (meta.data_source IS NULL OR data_source = meta.data_source) AND ts > s.ts
      ORDER BY ts LIMIT $n
    ) b
  ) exc ON true
  WHERE s.run_id = '${run_id}'
    AND $__timeFilter(s.ts)
)
SELECT AVG(mfe) / NULLIF(AVG(mae), 0) AS "Edge" FROM exc

panels.description: AVG(MFE) / AVG(MAE) over n bars. >2 = healthy, <1 = adverse exceeds favorable.

panels.title: Last Signal Age

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - MAX(ts)) / 3600.0 AS "Age" FROM signal_events s WHERE s.run_id = '${run_id}'

panels.description: Hours since last signal. >48hr may indicate system failure.

panels.title: Cumulative Signal Return (T+$n)
panels.description: Cumulative expected_direction x forward return. Pure signal edge accumulation.

targets.rawSql:
WITH meta AS ( SELECT symbol, timeframe, data_source FROM backtest_runs WHERE run_id='${run_id}'),
fwd AS (
  SELECT s.ts,
    (exit_bar.close - entry_bar.close) / NULLIF(entry_bar.close, 0) AS ret
  FROM signal_events s, meta
  JOIN LATERAL (SELECT close FROM ohlcv, meta WHERE symbol = meta.symbol AND timeframe = meta.timeframe AND (meta.data_source IS NULL OR data_source = meta.data_source) AND ts <= s.ts ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) entry_bar ON true
  JOIN LATERAL (SELECT close FROM ohlcv, meta WHERE symbol = meta.symbol AND timeframe = meta.timeframe AND (meta.data_source IS NULL OR data_source = meta.data_source) AND ts > s.ts ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1 OFFSET ($n - 1)) exit_bar ON true
  WHERE s.run_id = '${run_id}'
    AND $__timeFilter(s.ts)
)
SELECT ts AS time,
  SUM($expected_direction * ret) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS "Cumulative Return"
FROM fwd ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Rolling $k Mean Return (T+$n)
panels.description: Rolling k-signal average of adjusted forward return. Declining = edge weakening.

targets.rawSql:
WITH meta AS ( SELECT symbol, timeframe, data_source FROM backtest_runs WHERE run_id='${run_id}'),
fwd AS (
  SELECT s.ts,
    $expected_direction * (exit_bar.close - entry_bar.close) / NULLIF(entry_bar.close, 0) AS adj_return,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.ts) AS rn
  FROM signal_events s, meta
  JOIN LATERAL (SELECT close FROM ohlcv, meta WHERE symbol = meta.symbol AND timeframe = meta.timeframe AND (meta.data_source IS NULL OR data_source = meta.data_source) AND ts <= s.ts ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) entry_bar ON true
  JOIN LATERAL (SELECT close FROM ohlcv, meta WHERE symbol = meta.symbol AND timeframe = meta.timeframe AND (meta.data_source IS NULL OR data_source = meta.data_source) AND ts > s.ts ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1 OFFSET ($n - 1)) exit_bar ON true
  WHERE s.run_id = '${run_id}' AND $__timeFilter(s.ts)
)
SELECT ts AS time,
  AVG(adj_return) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN ($k - 1) PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Mean Return"
FROM fwd WHERE rn >= $k ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Rolling $k Edge Ratio (T+$n)
panels.description: Rolling k-signal AVG(MFE)/AVG(MAE). >2 = healthy, <1 = adverse exceeds favorable.

targets.rawSql:
WITH meta AS ( SELECT symbol, timeframe, data_source FROM backtest_runs WHERE run_id='${run_id}'),
exc AS (
  SELECT s.ts, exc.mfe, exc.mae,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.ts) AS rn
  FROM signal_events s, meta
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT close AS entry_close FROM ohlcv
    WHERE symbol = meta.symbol AND timeframe = meta.timeframe AND (meta.data_source IS NULL OR data_source = meta.data_source) AND ts <= s.ts
    ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
  ) entry_bar ON true
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      MAX((b.high - entry_bar.entry_close) / NULLIF(entry_bar.entry_close, 0)) AS mfe,
      MAX((entry_bar.entry_close - b.low) / NULLIF(entry_bar.entry_close, 0)) AS mae
    FROM (
      SELECT high, low FROM ohlcv
      WHERE symbol = meta.symbol AND timeframe = meta.timeframe AND (meta.data_source IS NULL OR data_source = meta.data_source) AND ts > s.ts
      ORDER BY ts LIMIT $n
    ) b
  ) exc ON true
  WHERE s.run_id = '${run_id}'
    AND $__timeFilter(s.ts)
)
SELECT ts AS time,
  AVG(mfe) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN ($k - 1) PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
  / NULLIF(AVG(mae) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN ($k - 1) PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0)
  AS "Edge Ratio"
FROM exc WHERE rn >= $k ORDER BY ts
